The '''Ossus Jedi Temple''' was a [[Jedi temple/Legends|Jedi temple]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], atop a plateau overlooking a large and deep canyon. One of the most ancient temples of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], it had been built when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] established on Ossus after leaving their homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]<ref name="TOR:RtP" /> at the end of the [[Force Wars]].<ref name="TNEC" />

The temple was destroyed when the planet Ossus was [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|devastated]] by the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]]<ref name="JvS" /> in [[3996 BBY]], during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Centuries later, during the [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Sith [[Invasion of Ossus|invaded]] Ossus. During the invasion, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malora]] unleashed her [[Mutated Geonosian]]s against the Jedi.<ref name="TOR:JUS">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Mutated Geonosian Queen}}</ref> Eventually, the Geonosians settled in the ruins of the Ossus Jedi Temple and the [[Mutated Geonosian queen|Geonosian queen]] established her [[Mutated Geonosian hive|hive]] in the caves beneath the temple.<ref name="TOR:HotMQ" />
